senses.gloss: औरग mfn. (fr. उर-ग), relating or belonging to a snake, serpentine, MBh.; Naiṣ.
औरग n. N. of the constellation Āśleṣā, L.
औरभ्र mfn. (fr. उर-भ्र), belonging to or produced from a ram or sheep, Mn. iii, 268; MBh.; Suśr. &c.
औरभ्र m. a coarse woollen blanket, L.
N. of a physician, Suśr.
औरभ्र n. mutton, the flesh of sheep
woollen cloth, W.
औरभ्रक n. a flock of sheep, Pāṇ. iv, 2, 39.
औरभ्रिक mfn. relating to sheep, W.
औरभ्रिक m. a shepherd, Mn. iii, 166.
(also) a sheep butcher, L. i.
औरव n. (fr. उरु), width, dimension, extension, spaciousness g. पृथ्व्-आदि, Pāṇ. v, 1, 122
औरव m. a descendant of Uru, N. of the Ṛṣi Arga.
औरश v.l. for 2. औरस below.
1. औरस mf(ई)n. (fr. उरस्), belonging to or being in the breast, produced from the breast, MBh.
innate, own, produced by one's self, Suśr.
औरस m. a sound produced from the breast, PārGṛ. iii, 16
an own son, legitimate son (one by a wife of the same caste married according to the prescribed rules), Mn. ix, 166, &c.; Yājñ. ii, 128, &c.; Hit.; R. &c.
2. औरस mfn. coming from or belonging to Uraśā g. सिन्ध्व्-आदि, Pāṇ. iv, 3, 93.
औरसी f. a legitimate daughter, Dāy.; Naiṣ.
औरसि m. a descendant of Uras (?).
औरसायनि m. a descendant of Uras g. तिकादि, Pāṇ. iv, 1, 154
a descendant of Aurasa, ib.
औरसिक mfn. like a breast g. अङ्गुल्य्-आदि, Pāṇ. v, 3, 108.
औरस्य mfn. belonging to or produced from the breast (as a sound)
produced by one's self, own, legitimate (cf. 1. औरस.)
औरा f. N. of a woman.
